name: Johnny Cage briefs Cassie's new-generation squad
description: Twenty years after Shinnok's imprisonment, Johnny Cage recounts the earlier Netherrealm conflict to a new squad led by Cassie Cage and including Jacqui Briggs, Takeda Takahashi, and Kung Jin. He then assigns them to contact Sub-Zero after the Lin Kuei Grandmaster goes silent, presenting retrieval by force as necessary if Sub-Zero will not cooperate.
